描述_EN: both the porcelain body and the decoration are of the highest quality and suggest that it was produced for the imperial use. inside the bowl there is a chinese character 'shou' (longevity) encircled by the eight buddhist emblems (bajixiang): wheel, conch-shell, umbrella, canopy, lotus flower, vase, pair of fishes and mystic knot. the symbolism alludes to happiness and long life. on the exterior, the same emblems and four medallions containing the characters wan shou wu jiang (ten thousand years of long life without end) are depicted. this high sided porcelain bowl was made at workshops in jingdezhen, southern china during the reign of the qianlong emperor (1736-1795) . the decorative design comprises numerous auspicious symbols suggesting that it may have been specially comissioned by the palace as a gift from the emperor.
描述_ZN: 瓷器的主体和装饰都是最高质量的，表明它是为皇室使用而制作的。 碗内有一个汉字 "寿"，周围有八个佛教标志（八吉祥）：车轮、海螺壳、伞、天幕、莲花、花瓶、一对鱼和神秘结。 象征性地暗示了幸福和长寿。 在外观上，描绘了同样的徽记和四个含有万寿无疆字样的徽章。 这个高边瓷碗是在乾隆年间在中国南方景德镇的工场制作的，是乾隆皇帝（1736-1795）的作品。 装饰设计包括许多吉祥的符号，表明它可能是由皇宫特别委托的，作为皇帝的礼物。
